## PaintFE 1.4.6

This update fixes background-removal results and adds editable selection shortcuts.

### Fixes

- Restored BiRefNet and U²-Net edge contrast while keeping IS-Net working. Fixed faint transparency in solid areas. Closes #162.
- Kept automatic model detection as the default. Manual overrides are tucked away and no longer remembered between uses.

### Shortcuts

- Added Clear Selected Pixels and Fill Selected Pixels to Preferences > Keybinds. Delete and Backspace remain the defaults, and both can be changed or unbound. Closes #164.

### Microsoft Store

- Release builds provide a downloadable MSIX in Actions for manual submission. Removed automated Store uploads and deployment approval.
